pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: app/rentgen/page.tsx:26 /rentgen mounts a "use client" feature whose h1 is server-rendered with an opacity-0, y-offset start state (useReducedMotion is null during SSR), so the route's largest paint waits for hydration; /graf/p/[ref] does the same through PermalinkPage's motion.h1.

techniques.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/VariantRentgen.tsx:343 The headline is served invisible and only script can reveal it, which is exactly the failure this technique names. The reduced-motion branch is null on the server, so it does not help the first render.

features/graph/PermalinkPage.tsx:559 Mounted by app/graf/p/[ref]/page.tsx:73. The citation h1 enters with a transform from a hidden state. Transform does not shift layout, but the headline is still invisible until script runs, which is the same start-state defect, here on the permalink route.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: app/page.tsx:60 The landing's streamed Deník slot falls back to a single loading line. The resolved DenikTeaser adds a day line, a cap note, up to four list rows and a SourceNote, so everything below the slot moves down when the ~12 s cold read resolves (the slot sits below the hero and ranking, so it shifts what the reader sees only once they have scrolled). Separately, the landing h1 is served at opacity 0.

techniques.evidence: features/landing/components/DenikTeaserPending.tsx:46 The placeholder reserves one text line. The loaded state renders a dayLine, a feedCapNote, a ul of titles and a SourceNote (DenikTeaser.tsx:92-123), so this is an approximate placeholder that shifts by the difference.
features/landing/components/HeroStory.tsx:40 The landing headline (the likely largest text element) is SSR'd at opacity 0 and becomes visible only after hydration.

app/layout.tsx:3 Fonts go through next/font: self-hosted on the document's origin, latin/latin-ext subsets, metric-adjusted fallback by default. The unused Fraunces family was removed with measured bytes. Plex Mono still ships four enumerated weights.
app/layout.tsx:110 The only third-party tag (Plausible) is env-gated and loads after interactive, not in the head. globals.css only imports tailwindcss, which is flattened at build.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: app/denik/loading.tsx:26 The /denik streaming shell paints its h1 with no SourceNote kicker, while DenikPage puts SourceNote tone="signal" above the same mt-3 h1. The placeholder is one kicker line short, so the masthead and everything below it drop when the cold server read resolves.

techniques.evidence: features/denik/DenikPage.tsx:326 The loaded masthead has a kicker row that loading.tsx omits. The placeholder is approximately right, not equal to the loaded geometry.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: app/hlasovani/loading.tsx:22 The /hlasovani streaming shell (shown during the ~16 s cold ledger read) sets the h1 with no eyebrow and no mt-3, while VoteTrackPage renders a SourceNote plus an mt-3 h1, so the masthead jumps down on stream-in. The loaded h1 is then served at opacity 0 until hydration.

techniques.evidence: features/votetrack/VoteTrackPage.tsx:66 The loaded masthead has a kicker row plus an mt-3 h1 (line 75); the loading shell reserves neither.

features/votetrack/VoteTrackPage.tsx:73 The headline's hidden start state is written into the served markup unconditionally (not even gated on reduced motion), so the largest paint waits for the client bundle to hydrate.
